items.title: US congressional investigation highlights gaps in federal response to global cyber scams
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, a Joint Economic Committee report finds that US government efforts against international scam compounds remain fragmented, with limited data on asset recovery.

items.title: Guardian readers share personal financial pressures following Budget 2026
items.summary: According to The Guardian, readers across the UK, from young workers to pensioners, detail how recent tax, housing and energy announcements impact their household budgets.

items.title: Databarracks wargames find crisis teams excel at communications but lag in technical cyber recovery
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, research from business continuity firm Databarracks reveals that organisational crisis teams score significantly higher on governance than on technical containment and clean restoration.

items.title: Cullum-backed MBP takes minority stake in rural broker Caleb Roberts
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, minority Broker Partnerships has acquired a minority stake in agricultural specialist Caleb Roberts Insurance Services to support its growth plans.

items.title: CII signs agreement to build Rwanda’s insurance skills
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, the Chartered Insurance Institute has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Association of Insurers in Rwanda to develop professional standards and certification pathways.

items.title: Databarracks wargames highlight gap between cyber communications and technical recovery
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, research from business continuity firm Databarracks shows corporate crisis teams score significantly higher on governance and communications than on technical cyber recovery.
